title: Routing is duplicated in serveClient: and responseForMethod:; tests only cover the copy, never the live socket path
evidence: BookServer.m:113-129 (serveClient:) vs BookServer.m:130-143 (responseForMethod:target:body:); Tests.m:8 calls only responseForMethod:. The two already diverge: serveClient: returns 400 for a non-object JSON body (BookServer.m:118), responseForMethod: silently coerces it to @{} (BookServer.m:132). Agent log: 'tests exercise request handling ... without opening a network socket, since this environment blocks local socket binding'
suggestion: Have serveClient: parse the request then delegate to responseForMethod: so one routing table exists and the tests cover the shipped path

title: Single serial accept loop with blocking recv and no timeout: one idle client stalls the whole server
evidence: BookServer.m:101 accept loop calls serveClient: inline on a DISPATCH_QUEUE_SERIAL queue; BookServer.m:106 recv() has no SO_RCVTIMEO
suggestion: Set a receive timeout and/or dispatch each client onto a concurrent queue (SQLite access serialised separately)

title: README promises a substring author filter; code does case-insensitive exact match with unescaped LIKE wildcards
evidence: README.md:23 'optional ?author= substring filter' vs BookServer.m:41 'WHERE author LIKE ?' bound to the raw value (no surrounding %, '%' and '_' in input act as wildcards)
suggestion: Use 'author = ?' (or LIKE with ESCAPE and explicit %...%) and make the README match

title: year is not type-validated; a non-numeric string is stored as 0
evidence: BookServer.m:62 binds [year integerValue] for anything responding to integerValue, so {"year":"abc"} persists year=0; validBookFields: (BookServer.m:89) checks only title/author
suggestion: Reject non-integer year (and non-string isbn) with 400

title: Book id parsed with integerValue, so /books/1abc resolves to book 1
suggestion: Validate the segment is all digits (NSScanner scanInteger + isAtEnd) before lookup

title: send() return values ignored; large responses can be truncated on a short write
evidence: BookServer.m:111 two bare send() calls, no loop on partial writes
suggestion: Loop until all bytes are written or an error occurs

title: All 8 checks live in one test function with a hand-rolled Check(); a failure doesn't isolate cases
evidence: Tests.m:5-18 TestServiceLogic with 8 Check() calls; no XCTest
suggestion: Split into per-behaviour test functions or use XCTest
